items.label: IMPOSSAMOLE+
items.why: Packed boot program includes the crack intro and trainer, then hands over to resident game entry $0810. Trainer energy is disabled in this run.

items.label: DYNAMIX->QUALITY
items.why: Packed level archive used by the patched loader. CPU stops at $04FA/$0508 and $16AE bracket decompression and capture all five payload IDs 0 through 4. Each payload supplies the map, block definitions, actors, sprites and charset listed in its level part.
